landmarks.name: Oriental Pearl Tower
visual_evidence: Tall tower with two large pink/purple spherical sections stacked vertically
Lower sphere covered in pink triangular glass panels
Upper smaller sphere with pink lattice pattern
Vertical column with a series of small pod-like balconies between spheres
Tripod-like angled legs with metallic spherical nodes near the base
Slender antenna spire at the top

scene_features: Row of colorful flags at the base of the tower
Low-rise buildings and a domed structure visible at the horizon
Trees and shrubbery in the foreground
Modern skyscrapers partially visible behind the tower base
